title: Leh-Ladakh Adventure
description: Explore the majestic landscapes of Leh-Ladakh. Thrilling high-altitude deserts, Buddhist monasteries, and scenic lakes await every adventure lover.

title: Rishikesh River Retreat
description: Experience the spiritual heart of India. Enjoy serene yoga retreats, vibrant Ganga aarti, and white-water rafting.

title: Pink City Jaipur
description: Discover royal palaces, vibrant bazaars, and impressive forts in Rajasthan’s historic capital.

title: Goa Beach Escape
description: Relax on sun-kissed beaches, enjoy vibrant nightlife, and explore the coastal charm of Goa.

title: Taj Mahal & Agra Fort
description: Marvel at the iconic Taj Mahal and nearby Agra Fort. A UNESCO World Heritage duo of love and Mughal grandeur.

title: Varanasi Spiritual Walk
description: Wander the ghats of the world’s oldest city. Witness Ganga aarti and discover the depth of Indian spirituality.

title: Kerala Backwaters Bliss
description: Drift on a houseboat through Kerala’s tranquil backwaters. Immerse yourself in vibrant culture and lush green scenery.

title: Udaipur Lakes & Palaces
description: Sail across Lake Pichola, explore glittering palaces, and enjoy the romance of Udaipur, India’s ‘City of Lakes’.
